blocks.text: Hushshell gives a quiet interval a portable form. Its overlapping plates preserve a simple opening gesture, while accounts of why quiet matters belong beside the object in the lore book.
A curved charcoal sleeping shell with three pale turquoise interlocking plates and a small amber bead.
One-shot use: The shell plates separate widely to reveal a tall amber spiral rising between them. The game performs the final fade.

26 silver. Stress / Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +12; Energy +8. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 5c5f4d26-3ceb-4e11-a04a-24fd8c45d587; animation b1c4995b-3c3a-41c7-9b18-201ac51cee66. Reduced motion holds a still.
